learningJourney.label: Learning journey
learningJourney.description: Learn about lac step by step, from its basics and biology to habitat, host plants and cultivation.
learningJourney.whatIsLac.title: What is lac?
learningJourney.whatIsLac.text: Start with a tiny living organism and understand lac and the natural resin produced by lac insects.
learningJourney.lifeCycle.title: Lac life cycle
learningJourney.lifeCycle.text: Follow the biology and development of lac insects, from the early stage through resin production.
learningJourney.habitat.title: Habitat & host plants
learningJourney.habitat.text: Learn the relationship between lac insects, host plants, the environment and growth.
learningJourney.hostPlants.title: Host plants
learningJourney.hostPlants.text: Discover plants associated with lac farming and the basics of selecting host trees.
learningJourney.lacFarming.title: Lac farming
learningJourney.lacFarming.text: Move from biology to practice: understand inoculation, care and harvesting.
